{{Quote|Send all troops in Sector Twelve to the South Slope to protect the fighters!|Leia Organa|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''South Slope''', also called the '''South Ridge''', was an area on the [[Clabburn Range/Legends|Clabburn Range]] of the ice [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that was immediately to the south of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] hidden [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].

==History==
[[File:SouthRidge-TESB.png|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker traverses the South Ridge]]
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] it was used as a staging area for evacuating [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that were to escort them past the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade of the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. As the situation grew dire, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] ordered additional troops to fall back to the South Slope in order to protect the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] against the possibility of attack by Imperial [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was waiting for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] aboard his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. Luke and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] both departed from this range.
